name: Entity Delta Formatter
description: A field formatter for entity_reference fields that renders only a chosen subset of the referenced entities, selected by delta (single positions, negative positions from the end, and ranges).
project_description: The Entity Delta Formatter module provides a single field formatter for entity_reference fields, "Rendered entities by delta" (plugin id entity_reference_delta_formatter). It extends core's Rendered entity (EntityReferenceEntityFormatter) formatter and adds a "Deltas" setting that limits which referenced items are rendered. Positions are 1-based; a negative number counts from the end (e.g. -2 is the second-to-last item), an underscore selects an inclusive range (e.g. 1_3), and commas combine several selections (e.g. "1_3, -1"). Selected items are still rendered through core entity_view(), so entity view access and field sanitization are unchanged.
